alternate_valid_findings: A precise supported gap in composition of caller increment and sleep, distinct from existing primitive assertions, may be accepted; absence of a composed test alone is not evidence of the historical bug.

A documented, material UTC-versus-local-time gap in absolute Retry-After handling may be accepted if the report proves the contract and explains why the clock mocks hide it. Do not require external history to credit a sound source argument.
Other scope-bound Retry cloning or status-timing defects/test gaps may be accepted when independently grounded.

contracts.contract: Retry attempts create new Retry objects with updated values; respect_retry_after_header controls respecting Retry-After on RETRY_AFTER_STATUS_CODES; independent status_forcelist can force response-status retries.
The status-retry production branch calls is_retry, increment, then sleep(response) before recursively requesting again.
Public callers configure Retry instances at pool level and per request.

limitations: Source-only: no target imports, tests, discovery, build, install, Docker, or execution occurred.
Each packet is a bounded selection of complete raw upstream files, not a runnable checkout. External dependencies and unrelated modules are absent.
Contracts, production callers, related tests and root test configuration are visible. Authoritative history and exact fixed-parent relations remain sealed from auditors.
Each packet is internally from one exact upstream commit. No authored target code, excerpt substitutions, injected comments, issue summaries, diffs, or targeted failure prompts are in packets.
Fixed controls deliberately include upstream regression assertions, while pre-fix twins naturally do not; the comparison uses identical packets across skill arms.
Public historical cases may have appeared in model training. Prior familiarity cannot be excluded, and packets disclose project identity through their unmodified contents.
Blinding is an instructed filesystem boundary, not an OS-enforced sandbox. Auditors must receive only one staged packet and must not browse history, sibling packets, rubric, or oracle.
Only the permitted prior protocol was inspected for exclusions. Prior audit outputs and the revised skill were not read.
Control means protected against the declared historical interaction, not proven defect-free or immune to other material test gaps.
oracle_challenges: The fixed regression assertions cover cloning and sleeping separately, not a full network status-retry cycle. A report must not be penalized solely for asking for a justified composition test.
Header-date tests mock local-time conversions. This control is not a claim that HTTP-date timezone handling is correct.
Redirect sleep_for_retry bypass paths are outside the declared response-status timing target; do not generalize the control to redirects.
protected_evidence: src/urllib3/util/retry.py:199-216 copies respect_retry_after_header in new(), and increment() calls new().
src/urllib3/util/retry.py:289-305 checks self.respect_retry_after_header before honoring response Retry-After; otherwise backoff applies.
test/test_retry.py:293-299 parametrizes both True and False and asserts propagation through new().
test/test_retry.py:301-347 uses positive numeric and absolute-date Retry-After values, both policy settings, mocked clock/sleep, and asserts calls versus no calls.
src/urllib3/connectionpool.py:806-821 is the real status-retry caller of increment() then sleep(response).
protected_false_alarms: Claiming that False is omitted from new() and therefore resets to the True default.
Claiming sleep(response) ignores respect_retry_after_header=False on the response-status retry path.
Claiming there are no assertions covering False-policy clone propagation or positive Retry-After with False-policy sleep.
scope: Retry policy preservation and timing of response-status retries through the pool request path.
target: Explicit Retry-After policy survives cloning and governs status retry sleep.
